definitions.short: Azarjah , the name of nineteen Israelites
definitions.full: H5838. Azaryah or Azaryahu עֲזַרְיָה עֲזַרְיָ֫הוּ, proper name, masculine ( ׳י hath helped ); Azariah (Old Hebrew עזריהו , Phoenician עזרבעל , Old Aramaic הדעדר הדדעזר, Lzb 338. 258 Cook 42 ); — Αζαριας : 1 king of Judah (Assyrian Azriyâ'û COT 2Kin 15:1 Jäger BAS i, 468 ) עֲזַרְיָהוּ 15:6 , 8 ; עֲזַרְיָה 14:21 ; 15:1 , 7 , 17 , 23 , 27 ; 1Chr 3:12 (see עֻזִּיָּה ). 2 יָהוּ +? 1Kin 4:5 . 3 id. prophet 2Chr 15:1 . 4 sons of Jehosh.: a. id,. 2Chr 21:2 . b. יָה - 2Chr 21:2 . 5 priests: a. יָהוּ - 1Kin 4:2 = יָה - 1 Chronicles 5:36; 1 Chronicles 5:37; Ezra 7:3 . b. יָה - 1 Chronicles 5:35 (twice in verse). c. id. , 1 Chronicles 5:39; 1 Chronicles 5:40; 1Chr 9:11 ; Ezra 7:1 . d. id. , Neh 10:3 . e. יָהוּ - 2Chr 31:10 , 13 , = יָה - 26:17 , 20 . 6 Levites, ׃י־ָהוּ a. 2Chr 29:12 . b. 2Chr 29:12 . ׃י־ָה c. 1Chr 6:21 . d. Neh 8:7 . 7 יָהוּ - a temple captain 2Chr 23:1 a (van d. H. יָה +? margin ), 23:1 b. 8 יָה +? Neh 3:23-24 ,. 9 יָה +? Zerubbabel Neh 7:7 ( שְׂרָיָה || Ezra 2:2 ). 10 יָה - Ezra 12:33. 11 יָהוּ - Epharimite 2Chr 28:12 . 12 יָה +? Judah: a. son of Ethan (!) 1Chr 2:8 . b. 1Chr 2:38 ; 2:39 . — For עֲזַרְיָהוּ 2Chr 22:6 read אֲחַזְיָה compare 22:7 . ** עֲזַרְיָה occurs also Jer 43:2 = (וִ)יזַנְיָה 42:1 (see above); and as friend of Danial Dan 1:6 ; 1:7 ; 1:11 ; 1:19 . עֲזַרְיָה proper name, masculine comrade of Daniel (Biblical Hebrew id. ; Dan 1:6 +); — 2:17 , = נְגוֺ עֲבֵד 2:49 +. עֵטָא see יעט .
definitions.rootNote: or עֲזַרְיָהוּ ; from 5826 and 3050 ; Jah has helped ;
